announcements.title: Fire Drill (Nov.10 Thursday 9:50am)
announcements.body:
Dear Students,
Bayside High School will conduct an emergency drill this week (week of Nov. 9th - Nov. 13th). This drill will focus on the General Response Protocols (GRP) for an Evacuation Drill (Fire Drill).
Please continue using the GRP Summary Guide ( www.schools.nyc.gov/school-life/safe-schools/emergency-readiness ) to discuss our responses with your child in advance of these drills.
Please feel free to contact me at tbollanos@schools.nyc.gov if you have any questions.
Thank you,
Themistoklis Bollanos
Assistant Principal
Student Life & Safety
announcements.bodyZh:
各位家长：
Bayside高中将于本周（11月9日至11月13日这一周）进行一次应急演练。本次演练的重点是针对疏散演练（消防演练）的“通用应对规程”（General Response Protocols，简称GRP）。
请继续参考“通用应对规程（GRP）摘要指南”（网址：www.schools.nyc.gov/school-life/safe-schools/emergency-readiness），在演练前与您的孩子讨论相关的应对措施。
如有任何疑问，欢迎通过电子邮件 tbollanos@schools.nyc.gov 与我联系。
谢谢！
Themistoklis Bollanos
副校长
负责学生生活与安全事务
